title: Occupancy and Residency Certification — Crediting Window by Certification History
content:
The **crediting window** applied to a mailed certification form on an Occupancy and Residency Certification profile rests on the certifications already recorded on the profile:

| Certifications recorded on the profile | Crediting window |
|---|---|
| one is recorded with a date less than 18 whole calendar months before the handling date | 60 days |
| certifications are recorded, but none that recent | 30 days |
| none is recorded | zero days |

Whole calendar months are counted as anniversaries of the day number, a month being complete only on the same day number of a later month.

*Boundary (hypothetical dates).* A certification dated 5 March of one year is recent on a handling date of 4 September of the following year (17 whole months) and no longer recent on 5 September (18 whole months).
